text.text_excerpt: Super cute yoga space I found through Groupon! I loved the loft feel and all the natural light that comes into this unique space. I'm also a fan that they offer noon classes, for those of us that enjoy our morning routines, this is the perfect mid day addition. They rotate teachers also so I was able to practice with a couple of different ones. I loved J.LOs class she offered a fantastic flow and incorporated tapping into our chakras. This studio also offers a variety of non yoga classes such as astrology, painting, yoga and vino. It's such a beautiful space and I'm so happy they are inviting the community to come in and explore various classes. I would definitely recommend this studio! I...

This yoga studio is so cute and a little hidden gem on a bustling part of magazine. They have affordable $8 community classes every week (I think twice a week). The yoga room is so bright with natural light from a big window at the front of the room. The yoga room is near the front and you take your shoes off right when you get in and walk to the back to register for class and put your stuff in a cubby. They have a lot of props and usually the instructors use a bunch during the class. I had never used a scarf in a yoga class before to help with stretching, and it was awesome.
